body:
zoe: Quick follow-up to the offload RFC — proposing a low-cost stochastic evictor that biases against allocations with low rehydrate cost and small size. Goal: reduce synchronized evict-and-refetch storms while preserving tail latency.

pat: Short bullets?

zoe: 1) keep deterministic watermarks for emergencies; 2) in normal pressure window, compute compact hotness h in [0,1] per slab (recency, freq, tenant weight, size bucket, est_rehyd_cost); 3) transform h via an exponential-tail CDF to produce p_evict; 4) clamp tenant scaling to avoid starvation; 5) cheap per-access updates + batched score evaluation.

liam: How small are per-alloc metadata and CPU hit?

zoe: Target 8B per allocation (u8 recency, u8 freq, u8 size_bucket, u8 flags, u32 epoch_tag). Fast-path only touches one byte most of the time. Full score eval happens in epoch worker.

sam: Pseudocode sketch pls (no deep detail).

zoe: on_access: sample++ on counters; epoch_tick: for each candidate: r=decay(recency); f=freq/255; s=size_penalty(bucket); c=norm(rehyd_cost); h=clamp(a*r + b*f - d*s - e*c,0,1); p=1 - exp(-k*h); tenant_scale = avg_w/ clamp(w_i, 0.5, 4.0); final_p = p * tenant_scale * pressure_factor; if rand() < final_p and now>cooldown evict.

pat: Cooldown and immediate rehydrate loops?

zoe: cooldown backoff proportional to recent recency; short-circuit to temporary non-evict if rehydrate bursts detected per-tenant.

liam: Telemetry/rollback plan?

zoe: telemetry: per-tenant evict_rate, post_evict_miss_rate, rehydrate_latency, churn. rollout: lab perf spike -> 1% canary -> ramp with automatic kill if 95p latency or post-evict miss delta exceeds thresholds.

ops-bot: Created ticket INF-4502: "stochastic-evictor-expt" assigned to zoe,liam,sam.

pat: Owners + next steps?

zoe: Zoe protos spike + perf harness (1wk), Liam implements cooldown/circuit automation, Sam dashboards + trace replay. I'll draft RFC follow-up with config schema. Sync Thurs.
